title: Riwayat tab opens with default filters and loads a list
preconditions: Signed in
steps: 1. Open Riwayat tab
expected_result: Title "Riwayat Transaksi"; default filters "7 Hari Terakhir" + "Semua Kategori"; loading skeleton then list

title: Empty state for the active filter keeps Sync ke Sheets and Reset Ekspor visible
preconditions: No transactions match the active filter
steps: 1. Apply a filter with no matching transactions
expected_result: "Belum ada riwayat transaksi." shown; Sync ke Sheets and Reset Ekspor buttons REMAIN visible (not dependent on list content)

title: Transactions grouped by day with correct labels
preconditions: Transactions exist across multiple days
steps: 1. View the list with transactions today yesterday and older
expected_result: Grouped by day, newest first; labels "Hari Ini", "Kemarin", else "D NamaBulan YYYY" (e.g. "5 Mei 2026")

title: Each row shows icon platform/category category-method note amount and delete button
preconditions: At least one transaction with a note
steps: 1. View a transaction row in the list
expected_result: Category icon, platform (or category if empty), "Kategori . Metode", note if present, amount prefixed "-", delete button

title: Time filter restricts the list to the selected range
preconditions: Transactions spanning more than 30 days
steps:
1. Select "Semua Waktu"
2. Select "7 Hari Terakhir"
3. Select "30 Hari Terakhir"
4. Select "3 Bulan Terakhir"
expected_result: Only transactions within the selected range shown each time; "3 Bulan Terakhir" = 90 days back (not 3 calendar months)

title: Category filter restricts the list to the selected category
preconditions: Transactions across multiple categories
steps: 1. Select a specific category filter
expected_result: Only transactions in that category shown; "Semua Kategori" shows all

title: Changing a filter resets to page 1
preconditions: On page 2+ of results
steps: 1. While on page 2 change the time or category filter
expected_result: Returns to page 1

title: Pagination shows 30 per page with correct button states
preconditions: More than 30 transactions match the filter
steps:
1. View page 1 (previous button should be disabled)
2. Click next to load older data
3. Continue until the last page (next button should be disabled)
expected_result: 30 transactions per page; previous disabled on page 1; next disabled when no more data; next loads older data with no duplicate/missing rows; indicator shows the REAL total pages and stays fixed (e.g. 1/5, 2/5 ... 5/5, not growing) also with a specific category filter active; with a category filter every page is full (30 rows, the last one the remainder), the total is exact (e.g. 1/2, 2/2) and no page is empty

title: Clicking a row opens the transaction detail modal
preconditions: At least one transaction in the list
steps: 1. Click a transaction row
expected_result: "Detail Pengeluaran" modal shows platform, full amount, category, method, full-format timestamp, note if present, and the "Edit Transaksi" + "Hapus Transaksi" buttons side by side

title: Delete icon or button opens a confirmation dialog
preconditions: At least one transaction in the list
steps: 1. Click the delete icon on a row, or "Hapus Transaksi" in the detail modal
expected_result: Confirmation dialog "Hapus Transaksi?" (irreversible) with "Batal" & "Hapus"

title: Confirming delete removes the transaction everywhere
preconditions: Delete confirmation dialog open
steps: 1. Click "Hapus"
expected_result: Transaction disappears from the list, from Home total, and from Ringkasan; detail modal (if open) also closes

title: Cancelling delete confirmation changes nothing
preconditions: Delete confirmation dialog open
steps: 1. Click "Batal"
expected_result: Nothing is deleted

title: New transaction from another tab/device appears on page 1
preconditions: Riwayat open on page 1, second session available
steps: 1. Add a transaction from another tab/device while viewing page 1
expected_result: New transaction appears automatically on page 1

title: Detail modal shows Edit Transaksi and Hapus Transaksi side by side
preconditions: At least one transaction in the list
steps: 1. Click a transaction row
expected_result: Both "Edit Transaksi" and "Hapus Transaksi" buttons shown side by side

title: Edit Transaksi opens a pre-filled edit modal with the same validation as SAVE
preconditions: Detail modal open for a transaction
steps:
1. Click "Edit Transaksi"
2. Check the fields
3. Try the SAVE-07 combo-box, SAVE-08 price limit and negative value, and SAVE-09 200-char note rules
expected_result: Detail modal closes; edit modal opens pre-filled with that transaction; validation rules behave exactly as SAVE-06..09

title: Transaction date/time cannot be changed from the edit modal
preconditions: Edit modal open for an older transaction
steps:
1. Inspect the edit modal fields
2. Save a change
3. Check the day group in Riwayat
expected_result: No date/time field exists; transaction stays under its original day

title: Saving an edit updates Riwayat, Home and Ringkasan
preconditions: Edit modal open for a transaction inside the current month
steps:
1. Change the price and category
2. Click "Simpan Perubahan"
3. Check Riwayat, Home and Ringkasan (monthly + weekly if in range)
expected_result: Modal closes; change shows immediately in Riwayat; final numbers in Home/Ringkasan reflect the edit (old category amount reduced, new one increased)

title: Closing the edit modal discards changes
preconditions: Edit modal open with changes made
steps:
1. Change fields
2. Click the close (X)
expected_result: Changes discarded; transaction unchanged in the list

title: Save failure shows an error toast and leaves the list unchanged
preconditions: Edit modal open; connection/server failure induced (e.g. block the Firestore request in DevTools or stop the emulator)
steps:
1. Change a field
2. Click "Simpan Perubahan"
expected_result: Error toast "Gagal menyimpan perubahan: ..."; list unchanged

title: Confirming delete while offline closes the dialog at once and syncs deletion and summary after reconnect
preconditions: Online, Riwayat tab with at least two transactions, then offline
steps:
1. Go offline
2. Delete a transaction and confirm "Hapus"
3. Observe the dialog and the list
4. Go online and wait for sync
5. Compare Ringkasan with the transactions in Riwayat
expected_result: Dialog closes immediately and the row disappears (no hanging spinner); after reconnect the deletion and the Ringkasan correction are synced together (Ringkasan total equals the Riwayat sum). If the server rejects, an error toast appears and the row returns to the list (not forceable locally)
